snippet.title: Boardwalk Builders | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A game all about building a beautiful boardwalk.  Start with small stands and grow into a sprawling seaside paradise full of rides, high-end shops and fancy restaurants. 

Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds. Manage and combine businesses to create bigger and better attractions. Host festivals, attract VIPs and stay ahead of shifting demand influenced by local events and rival businesses.  Watch life unfold on your peaceful promenade!  

Wishlist on Steam:
